question_text:
Ziconotide was injected at 3 ng kg⁻¹ h⁻¹ for 8 days into each patient.

1 ng = 1 × 10⁻⁹ g

Calculate the total mass in grams of ziconotide injected after 8 days into a patient with a body mass of 82 kg

Show your working.

points.text: Answer of 5 or 47(232) with incorrect order of magnitude = 1 mark
Answer of 2/1.9(68) x 10⁻⁶ (i.e., not multiplied by 24) = 1 mark
Answer of 6/5.8/5.76 x 10⁻⁷ (i.e., not multiplied by 82) = 1 mark
Answer of 2/1.6/1.57(44) x 10⁻⁵ (i.e., not multiplied by 3) = 1 mark
Answer of 6/5.9/5.904 x 10⁻⁶ (i.e., not multiplied by 8) = 1 mark;

accept.text: any equivalent numerical representation of the correct answer.
